title: LH Surge
text: Around day 14, high oestrogen levels trigger a sudden surge (rapid increase) in LH from the pituitary gland.

title: LH and Ovulation
text: The LH surge causes the mature follicle (Graafian follicle) to rupture and release its egg. This process is called ovulation. LH also converts the empty follicle into the corpus luteum.
